rationale: S2 appends 7 per-actor task command classes (plus a file-private readGroupEpoch3P helper) to the existing e2e/tests/multi-user-3p.property.spec.ts created by S1. No prior task-command tests exist for this target. The file already contains the S1 skeleton: ModelState3P, RealSystem3P, the beforeAll/afterAll lifecycle, cachedPubkeyA/B/C, and exactly one placeholder test under one test.describe.serial.

discovery_baseline.note: One test definition fanned out across the three configured Playwright projects (chromium + Mobile Chrome + Mobile Safari). The S1 placeholder test works and lists cleanly.

regression_target.explanation: S2 adds only command CLASSES, not test definitions. The command set is wired into the fc.commands array by S5, not S2. Therefore the test count is unchanged (still exactly one definition / 3 listed). The 7 new classes are intentionally unreferenced in S2 — they become live arbitraries in S5. e2e/ is not in tsconfig include and there is no root eslint gate, so unused-symbol lint does not apply (exploration.json conventions.tsconfig_eslint).
